## Design

### 2026-10-12 – Today I signed up for onshape and got the free plan.

**1h**

Today I signed up for onshape and got the free plan.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xLV9v2yZsf8cQU2Q5GZ9YV3OSKXKe8Gz/75a195c283fbd443b5fd0d394239f516e219dd1ed40fa4225965664fcbb7b1ed.png)

The guide seems focused on showing how to use the platform and then I'll have to come up with my own design which is pretty cool. I had to do the obligatory idea reel, so I had to take a few moments to think over what I wanted to do, but I was somewhat unsure so I tried looking in the doomscroller and saw that the guy doing the same project just introduced the project of the week and decided that I should follow a similar format as I wasn't too sure as to what I wanted to do. I did decide on a funnel, as I want to  see the marbles spin around and slowly go into the hole. I thought it would feel satisfying.

I followed the guide part I.base, it was rather confusing as it was a new software program. The guide measured everything in mm, but the default measurement was inches unfortunately, but I was able to eventually figure out how to by asking the built in AI.

I struggled a lot with the sketch button as it was confusing and worked oddly until I finally got it down. But I managed well enough to do all of this within an hour --->

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xLV9v2yZsf8cQU2Q5GZ9YV3OSKXKe8Gz/6188bfe392a34a5373c2ded57dd8eb4d5da614ea4de88568bf2adb638591d719.png)
